whatIs.title: Waa maxay Autobot?
whatIs.description: Autobot waa portal maamul oo caqli leh oo leh chatbot RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Wuxuu awood u siinayaa maamulayaasha inay soo geliyaan dokumentiyada oo u oggolaado isticmaalayaasha inay ku weydiiyaan su'aalo luuqad dabiici ah, iyada oo ay shaqeynayso AI.

howItWorks.title: Sida uu u Shaqeeyo
howItWorks.description: Dokumentiyada waa la farsameeyaa, waa la jajabiyaa, waxaana la geliyaa kaydka vector-ka. Markaad su'aal weydiiso, nidaamku wuxuu soo saaraa qaybaha dokumentiga ugu habboon oo wuxuu ku abuuraa jawaab macnaha ku habboon isagoo adeegsanaya qaabka AI.

gettingStarted.title: Bilow
gettingStarted.subtitle: Raac tillaabooyinkan si aad u dejiso Autobot oo u bilaabato isticmaalida chatbot-ka RAG ku shaqeeya dokumentiyadaada.

uploadDocuments.title: Soo geli Dokumentiyada
uploadDocuments.description: Soo geli faylasha PDF, DOCX, ama TXT oo uu chatbot-ku isticmaali doono sida saldhiga aqoonta.
details: Noocyada la taageeray: PDF, DOCX, TXT
Dokumentiyada si otomaatig ah ayaa loo farsameeyaa oo loo geliyaa
Maamul faylasha la soo geliyay dashboard-ka dokumentiyada
